An unofficial desktop app for Tailscale. Not made by or affiliated with Tailscale Inc.

## Install

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Arch Linux | `yay -S tailscale-desktop-unofficial-bin` |
| macOS | `brew install --cask marcusbandit/tap/tailscale-desktop-unofficial` |
| Windows | `winget install MarcusBandit.TailscaleDesktopUnofficial` |

Or download the file for your system below. Tailscale itself has to be installed and running.

**macOS:** the app is not signed with an Apple Developer ID yet. The first time, macOS says it
can't check the app. Open System Settings, Privacy & Security, scroll down and press **Open
Anyway**. Homebrew does this step for you.

**Windows:** the exe is not code signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn the first time. Press
**More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Like it? You can [buy me a coffee on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/marcusbandit).
